name: Shared identity
description: Customers connected into one identity cluster through a shared phone number or mailing address.

name: KYC review candidate
description: An account whose owning customer belongs to a shared-identity cluster containing more than one customer.

name: Transfer exposure
description: Directed account-to-account money movement and the accounts exposed through those transfers.

name: Fraud-ring candidate
description: An account or community whose transfer topology and graph-derived scores meet the configured ring-candidate thresholds.

name: High risk
description: The lakehouse risk tier assigned from ring-community membership, supported by graph centrality and community evidence.
